note: Who stands at each town marker (look layer, visual only). Archetypes and poses are the beauty corner's CharacterKit ones (content/look/characters.json). 'roles' is the default per marker role; 'markers' overrides one marker by id. 'face' is a marker id to look toward; with no 'face', characters look toward the middle of the town bounds. Figures are static: no AI, no collision, no dialogue (that comes later).
